analysis: The code snippet is a REST endpoint method that extracts an access token from HTTP headers or form parameters, then calls issueUserInfo(accessToken). It also calls checkAccessTokenDuplicated if the token is from form parameters. Potential runtime exceptions: issueUserInfo() throws CorsErrorResponseException (a RuntimeException intended to propagate to an uncaught exception handler), and deeper calls may throw NullPointerException, UnsupportedOperationException, etc. Similarly, checkAccessTokenDuplicated() throws CorsErrorResponseException. These runtime exceptions are typically handled by a global JAX-RS exception mapper, not within this snippet. Catching them locally would interfere with the intended error handling and is unnecessary. Therefore, no optimization is required.
